name: robustness_full_boolq_dora
description: Robustness check (paper Appendix J): Cell 1 BoolQ DoRA roberta-base at full BoolQ training set (9.4K) to verify direction agrees with the 7K subsample audit. 5 seeds × paired LoRA. Reserved for camera-ready execution.
base_command: python3 real_lora_classify.py --model roberta-base --dataset super_glue --dataset-config boolq --train-split train --eval-split validation --text-field-a question --text-field-b passage --label-field label --metric accuracy --output-dir . --peft-method {peft_method} --lr 0.0002 --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lora-dropout 0.05 --num-epochs 2 --batch-size 8 --seq-length 256 --seed {seed}
notes: Compared against e5_rank16_dora_boolq.json (subsample max_samples=7000, eval=1500). This config omits --max-samples to use the full BoolQ training set (~9.4K) and full validation set (~3.3K). Paired: 5 seeds × {lora, dora} = 10 runs. Statistical test: project_a_pairwise_summary.py with one-sided sign-flip for DoRA > LoRA pre-specified direction.
